answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces superlinear attacker costs. Verifiers map the graph like an atlas to identify bottleneck topological cuts; forged clusters lacking genuine external ties get isolated. Auditors sign cross-examinations with an identity quill, while collateral acts as a valuable pearl bonded by every node. When fraud is detected, stake slashing destroys colluding clusters, making Sybil expansion superlinearly expensive.
